name: Crimson Wraith increases critical strike damage bonus at both ranks
contract: Crimson Wraith is SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS (163) with EffectMiscValue SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_ALL (127): rank 1 (504560) base points 9 (raw 10, 10%), rank 2 (504880) base points 19 (raw 20, 20%). This aura type is handled natively in Unit.cpp via GetTotalAuraModifierByMiscMask/GetTotalAuraMultiplierByMiscMask, with no per-spell CoA code required. Issue #1928 reported no handler exists for either rank; this proves both ranks deliver the tooltip's percentage through the native mechanism.

steps.label: Rank 1 aura settles on the caster
Rank 2 aura settles on the caster
